title.zh: 将西内格罗斯省Asia市镇更名为Hinoba-An市镇的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Asia, Province of Occidental Negros, to Municipality of Hinoba-An
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Asia, Province of Occidental Negros, to Municipality of Hinoba-An

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2154_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Municipality of Asia, Province of Occidental Negros, is changed to Municipality of Hinoba-an, and its seat of government shall be, as it is now, the site of the present barrio of Hinoba-an.
Executive Order Numbered One hundred eighty-six, series of 1948, is amended accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 24, 1959.
